'''Pellko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Pellko worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and had a network of informants, so knew a lot about what went on in the cities of [[Gadrin]] and [[Hedrett]], on Cularin. He was present in the bar [[Spanner's]] in Hedrett, when it was visited by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].

==Personality and traits==
Pellko was a very fastidious person and was well-groomed. He liked to be in control of things, and liked it when people owed him favors, but hated owing debts to others.
